name: Canonical 5-stage analyze -> plan -> implement -> verify -> revise workflow

tasks.prompt: Explore the repository layout, module boundaries, and existing tests. Produce verified architecture_facts and a concise shared interface_packet locking types, signatures, and invariants for parallel implementers.

mock_result.architecture_facts: Parser lives in internal/parser; formatter lives in internal/format; both depend only on internal/model.
mock_result.interface_packet: Contract: Token{Kind string, Value string}; Parse(src string) ([]Token, error); Format(tokens []Token) (string, error).

tasks.prompt: Using architecture_facts and interface_packet, split implementation into disjoint cell_spec_a and cell_spec_b scopes with explicit file ownership and acceptance checks.

mock_result.cell_spec_a: Cell A owns internal/parser: implement Parse(src string) ([]Token, error) and unit tests.
mock_result.cell_spec_b: Cell B owns internal/format: implement Format(tokens []Token) (string, error) and unit tests.

tasks.prompt: Implement cell_spec_a strictly against the shared interface_packet. Return diff_a and a separate self_assessment.

mock_result.diff_a:
diff --git a/internal/parser/parse.go b/internal/parser/parse.go
+func Parse(src string) ([]Token, error) { ... }
mock_result.self_assessment: Producer note: parser handles quoted tokens and passed local tests.

tasks.prompt: Implement cell_spec_b strictly against the shared interface_packet. Return diff_b and a separate self_assessment.

mock_result.self_assessment: Producer note: formatter round-trips tokens cleanly.

tasks.prompt: Independently verify diff_a and diff_b against interface_packet without producer self-assessment summaries. Return review_verdict and concrete revision_notes.

mock_result.revision_notes: Ensure Format escapes trailing backslashes identically to Parse unescaping rules in interface_packet.

tasks.prompt: Apply revision_notes to diff_a and diff_b while keeping full compliance with interface_packet, and produce accepted_patch.

mock_result.accepted_patch: Combined patch aligning internal/parser and internal/format backslash escaping with interface_packet; all verification checks pass.
